Comparison

An honest comparison — including where we are not the right choice.

Every platform in this category does something well. Here is a side-by-side view so you can pick deliberately rather than by logo recognition.

See our pricingTest one release
Quick answer PressCosmos competes with PR Newswire, EIN Presswire, IssueWire, 24-7 Press Release and OpenPR. We differentiate on three axes: AI answer-engine visibility included at every price point, human editorial review on all plans, and branded newsroom hosting so earned authority accrues to your own domain. Legacy wires still lead on regulated corporate disclosure scale; low-cost platforms lead on price alone.

Fit

When you should not choose us

You need the absolute lowest price

If the goal is a syndicated link at minimum cost and nobody will read it, a free or freemium platform is a rational purchase. We will not pretend otherwise.

You need a legacy wire name for a regulated filing

Some disclosure regimes and counsel teams expect a specific incumbent wire. That is a legitimate constraint, not a marketing problem.

You want zero editorial involvement

We review every release. If your process requires publishing unread copy instantly with no gate, we are the wrong fit.

Answers

Comparison questions

Still stuck? Talk to a specialist

It depends on what you need. Legacy wires such as PR Newswire are strongest for regulated, large-scale corporate disclosure. Low-cost self-serve platforms such as IssueWire and OpenPR are best for volume at minimum cost. PressCosmos is built for teams who need distribution plus AI answer-engine visibility, with human editorial review on every release at mid-market pricing.

For a link you can show a client, often yes. For an announcement where the business outcome depends on a journalist or an AI assistant picking it up, distribution quality and formatting usually matter more than the fee difference.

Yes, and plenty of teams do. Some run a premium wire for material news and a lower-cost lane for routine updates. PressCosmos reports citations and backlinks against any campaign, not only our own distribution.

Answer-engine formatting is included on every plan rather than sold as an upgrade; AI citation tracking across nine engines is reported alongside traffic; and branded newsroom hosting is available on any plan so authority accrues to your own domain.
